entries.name: R2A.WORDS
entries.note: space-separated String -> Vector of its non-empty words

entries.name: R1C.REVENUE
entries.body: [ 'XR' BIND XR 'qty' GET XR 'price' GET MUL 0 XR 'price' GET NIL? NOT SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
entries.note: Orders Vector -> exact total of qty times price over the orders that have a price.

entries.name: R2B.SPACEJOIN
entries.note: Vector of Strings -> the Strings joined by single spaces.

entries.name: R2D.PRESENT
entries.note: Vector -> the elements that are not NIL, in order

entries.name: R2D.STREAKS
entries.note: Boolean Vector -> same-length Vector of running counts of consecutive TRUEs, reset to 0 at each FALSE

entries.name: R2B.BSIGN
entries.note: Bracket char -> 1 for an opener, -1 for a closer.

entries.name: R2B.BDEPTH
entries.body: CHARS [ R2B.BSIGN ] MAP 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
entries.note: Bracket String -> greatest number of brackets open at once (open count never below 0).

entries.name: R2D.LONGEST-GAP
entries.note: Vector -> length of the longest run of consecutive NILs (0 when none)
